You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

from collections import deque
s='''000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000011111
000000000000000000000000010001
000000000000000000000000010001
000001111100000000111000110001
000001000111000000101000100001
000001000001000000101000111111
000001000001000000111000000000
000001111001000000000000000000
000000001001000000000000000000
000000001111000000000000000000
000000000000000000000111111000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000000000000000000100001000
000000001111111110000111101000
000000001000000010000000000000
000000001000000000000000000000
000000001000000010000000000000
000000001000000000000000000000
000000001111000010000000000000
000000000001000010000011111000
000000000001000010000010001000
000000000001111110000011001000
000000000000000000000001001000
000000000000000000000001111000
000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000000000
000000000000000000000000000000'''.split()
g=[list(map(int,x)) for x in s]; R=C=30
# 8-components of ones
seen=set(); comps=[]
for r in range(R):
 for c in range(C):
  if g[r][c]==1 and (r,c) not in seen:
   cells={(r,c)}; seen.add((r,c)); q=deque(cells)
   while q:
    x,y=q.popleft()
    for dx in (-1,0,1):
     for dy in (-1,0,1):
      if not(dx or dy): continue
      z=(x+dx,y+dy)
      if 0<=z[0]<R and 0<=z[1]<C and g[z[0]][z[1]]==1 and z not in seen:
       seen.add(z);cells.add(z);q.append(z)
   comps.append(cells)
# global zero components 4-neighbor, note enclosed ones
zseen=set(); holes=[]
for r in range(R):
 for c in range(C):
  if g[r][c]==0 and (r,c) not in zseen:
   cells={(r,c)};zseen.add((r,c));q=deque(cells); edge=False
   while q:
    x,y=q.popleft()
    if x in (0,R-1) or y in (0,C-1):edge=True
    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
     z=(x+dx,y+dy)
     if 0<=z[0]<R and 0<=z[1]<C and g[z[0]][z[1]]==0 and z not in zseen:zseen.add(z);cells.add(z);q.append(z)
   if not edge:
    adj=set()
    for x,y in cells:
     for dx in (-1,0,1):
      for dy in (-1,0,1):
       z=(x+dx,y+dy)
       if 0<=z[0]<R and 0<=z[1]<C and g[z[0]][z[1]]==1:adj.add(z)
    owners=[i for i,co in enumerate(comps) if adj&co]
    holes.append((cells,owners))
print('8-connected ones components',len(comps))
for i,co in enumerate(comps): print(i,len(co),(min(x for x,y in co),max(x for x,y in co),min(y for x,y in co),max(y for x,y in co)))
print('holes',[(len(c),o,(min(x for x,y in c),max(x for x,y in c),min(y for x,y in c),max(y for x,y in c))) for c,o in holes])
# Output: only components owning enclosed regions; 2 exterior halo around component, 3 halo inside cavity
out=[x[:] for x in g]
for cells,owners in holes:
 for i in owners:
  co=comps[i]
  hole_set=set(cells)
  # 3 all hole cells 8-adjacent to the component
  for r,c in hole_set:
   if any((r+dx,c+dy) in co for dx in (-1,0,1) for dy in (-1,0,1) if dx or dy):out[r][c]=3
  # 2 outside background 0s 8-neighbor to this component
  for r,c in co:
   for dx in (-1,0,1):
    for dy in (-1,0,1):
     if not(dx or dy):continue
     z=(r+dx,c+dy)
     if 0<=z[0]<R and 0<=z[1]<C and g[z[0]][z[1]]==0 and z not in hole_set:
      out[z[0]][z[1]]=2
print('OUTPUT')
for row in out: print(' '.join(map(str,row)))
